description: A race with a deadline runs as a race between its members and a timeout task (DSL 3.5). t.2's budget deadline 200 is inherited by the timeout wrapper; the driver advances past it, the wrapper's own Cx is cancelled with Deadline (origin the wrapper, t.2/g1.timeout), and the race reports that Cx reason (cx.cancel_reason(), cx/scope.rs:1365-1367). C reported origin t.2. Minimized from fuzz case gen-667-113 (twin_run minimize, bd-uyd3).
